title: vuralia turcica
intro: Vuralia turcica, commonly known as Turkish angelica, is a plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help to alleviate various health issues including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Vuralia turcica include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues, and as a carminative, easing digestive discomfort. The bioactive constituents of Vuralia turcica include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
